name: MonarchFileList
title: FileList
summary: A list or grid of files with optional selection, a place for each file's actions, a bar of actions for the selected files and an empty state.
whenToUse: To show the files of a project, a folder or a record, where people open, select and act on several files at once.
whenNotToUse: For one file, use MonarchFileCard. For files being uploaded, use the upload queue. For a folder hierarchy, use MonarchTreeView.
api: @Composable fun MonarchFileList(items: List<MonarchFileListItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, layout: MonarchFileListLayout = MonarchFileListLayout.List, selected: Set<String> = emptySet(), onSelectedChange: ((Set<String>) -> Unit)? = null, onOpen: ((MonarchFileListItem) -> Unit)? = null, label: String? = null, bulkActions: List<MonarchBulkAction> = emptyList(), state: LazyGridState = rememberLazyGridState(), labels: MonarchFileListLabels = MonarchFileListLabels(), empty: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable (MonarchFileListItem) -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchFileListItem(id: String, name: String, sizeBytes: Long? = null, contentType: String? = null, meta: String? = null, image: Painter? = null, badges: List<String> = emptyList(), enabled: Boolean = true)

class MonarchFileListLabels(selectAll: String? = null, empty: String? = null, card: MonarchFileCardLabels = MonarchFileCardLabels(), bulkActionBar: MonarchBulkActionBarLabels = MonarchBulkActionBarLabels())

options.name: items
options.description: The files in display order: id, name, size, MIME type, meta, image, badges and enabled.

options.name: layout
options.description: List: one row per file. Grid: cards with previews in adaptive columns at least 160dp wide, wider at larger font scales.

options.name: selected
options.description: The ids of the selected files. Shown only with onSelectedChange.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Makes the files selectable: a checkbox on each file, "Select all files" and the bulk action bar. Receives the new set of ids.

options.name: onOpen
options.description: Opens a file, for example in a preview. Makes each enabled file a button.

options.name: label
options.description: The TalkBack name of the files, such as "Project files".

options.name: bulkActions
options.description: Actions for the selection (Download, Move, Delete), shown in MonarchBulkActionBar while any file is selected.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the files.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Select all files", the empty title, and the strings of the cards and the bar.

options.name: empty
options.description: Replaces the built-in empty state when there are no files, for example with an upload action.

options.name: actions
options.description: Each file's actions, such as a button that opens a DropdownMenu, at the end of a row or the top end of a card.

states.name: read only
states.description: Without onSelectedChange: the files only, as rows or cards.

states.name: selectable
states.description: Each file has a checkbox and "Select all files" heads the list.

states.name: some selected
states.description: Select all is mixed and the bulk action bar shows the count, the actions and Clear selection.

states.name: all selected
states.description: Select all is checked; pressing it clears the selection.

states.name: file disabled
states.description: The file cannot be opened or selected and is left out of select all.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState with "No files yet", or the app's empty content.

appearance: Rows and cards are MonarchFileCards on the surface role with a subtle border; a selected file has the subtle accent fill and a thicker accent border. The select all row uses the Material 3 checkbox in Monarch's accent colors and the bulk bar MonarchBulkActionBar's raised surface. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map named LazyColumn or LazyVerticalGrid: both layouts are one LazyVerticalGrid (one fixed column for rows, adaptive columns for cards), so the list scrolls itself and needs a bounded height; it cannot sit inside a verticalScroll. iOS stacks the cards in the app's scroll view instead. The web shows "3 files selected" beside select all; on Android, as on iOS, the count, the actions and Clear selection are MonarchBulkActionBar, which also announces each change. The web's renderActions and bulkActions slots are an actions slot per file and MonarchBulkAction values. Shift-click ranges have no touch equivalent and are not offered. Escape clears the selection with a hardware keyboard. Selection is hoisted as selected and onSelectedChange, as in Compose, where iOS takes a Binding. The web's uncontrolled defaultSelectedIds and its links (href) are not offered: the app owns the selection and opens files in onOpen.
accessibility: Select all is one TalkBack element with the checkbox role and a checked, mixed or unchecked state; it is disabled when no file can be selected.
Each file's checkbox is named "Select <file name>" and announced as checked or not checked; a disabled file's checkbox is disabled.
The picture, name and meta of a file are one element, a button when onOpen is set (MonarchFileCard).
The bulk action bar announces the count when it changes and "Selection cleared" when it empties.
The files carry the label as their TalkBack name and the lazy grid's collection information.
Every control has a 48dp touch target; names wrap at the largest font scale and grid columns widen with it.
edgeCases: Ids in selected that are no longer in items are not counted; clear them in the app when files are deleted.
With only disabled files, select all is disabled.
Pressing select all while it is mixed selects every enabled file.
Long file names wrap in rows and cards.
